verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a separate federal instance that is FedRAMP-compliant. This gives customers a distinct hosted environment to choose, which is a narrow form of data-residency choice. The Relay Proxy only proxies flag streams on your own infrastructure; it is not data storage residency, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: general region selection (e.g., EU/US/APAC data residency), documentation of where data is stored per instance, any statement that the federal instance is a residency control, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This instance is compliant with the United States government’s Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP).
